name: lib2geom
note: Keep all 25 tests. Add -ffp-contract=off to CXXFLAGS to preserve separate rounding in geometry algorithms on FMA-capable x86-64-v3 CPUs. Use ctest --output-on-failure so any future failure includes assertions. An inline prepare patch handles exact identical/reversed segment endpoints without reprojecting them, which fixed the remaining coincident-intersection failure. All 25 tests passed locally.
